source.name: Football Shirt Culture - AS Roma 2026-27 Home Kit by Adidas Revealed
source.quote: Eurobet.live is displayed as the main shirt sponsor in yellow across the front.

source.name: Yahoo Sports (Football Italia) - Official: Roma unveil new adidas home kit for 2026-27
source.quote: Last season's back-of-shirt and sleeve sponsors Auberge Collection and Wizz Air will retain their places on the home kits, but there will be a new front-of-shirt sponsor: Eurobet.live.

source.name: AS Roma - Auberge Resorts Collection becomes club's Main Global Partner
source.quote: their logo will now also appear on the back of all match shirts worn by the men’s, women’s and Primavera sides.

source.name: Yahoo Sports (Football Italia) - Official: Roma unveil new adidas home kit for 2026-27
source.quote: Last season's back-of-shirt and sleeve sponsors Auberge Collection and Wizz Air will retain their places on the home kits, but there will be a new front-of-shirt sponsor: Eurobet.live.

source.name: AS Roma - AS Roma announces new strategic partnership with Wizz Air
source.quote: The agreement will see Wizz Air become a Main Partner of the Club and includes a shirt-sleeve sponsorship, which will make its first appearance on the team's kit on 15 December.

summary: Adidas home shirt with Eurobet.live on the front, Auberge Collection on the back and Wizz Air on the sleeve. All three are consumer brands with no state owner found; the club itself is owned by the Friedkin family's private group, which also owns Auberge Collection.
